author: T. R. James
title: Keith Self discusses anniversary of event and promotes "Sharia-Free" caucuses - Collin Times
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a U.S. Congressman from Texas, posted several messages on his social media account on March 31, 2026, addressing issues related to recent history and legislative initiatives.
In one post dated March 31, 2026, Self referenced an event from two years prior: “Hard to believe this atrocity was two years ago today. Thank God for @POTUS and biological truth. https://t.co/IDgCRxZlqD”.
Later that day, he discussed the founding of a new caucus in Congress: “In Congress, @RepChipRoy and I—two Texans—founded the Sharia-Free America Caucus. Shortly after, @BrentMoneyTX founded the Sharia-Free Texas Caucus in the Texas House of Representatives. A Sharia-Free Caucus should be established in every state! DON’T SHARIA OUR AMERICA! “
A previous post on March 31 included only a link: https://t.co/CtHIQKw1sn.
Keith Self has been active in electoral politics over recent cycles. In 2024, he won re-election by defeating Sandeep Srivastava with 62.5% of the vote compared to Srivastava’s 37.6%. Two years earlier, in 2022, Self also defeated Srivastava with a margin of 60.5% to 36.9%.
